title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow auto-rollback workflow and safety guards
author: Jordan Lee
release_notes: Adds a unified rollout workflow combining canary, A/B and shadow modes with metric-driven auto-rollback and safety guards. Backwards compatible; config flags default to existing behavior.
description:
Motivation: We need a single, extensible rollout workflow that supports (1) progressive canaries, (2) A/B experiments, and (3) shadow probing of candidate models while providing automatic rollback when key SLOs degrade. This PR implements the controller, policy evaluation, and safety gates required to run these rollouts reliably in Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.

Summary of changes: controller and state machine for unified rollouts; new policy DSL extensions for multi-mode rollouts; metric matching and quarantine logic for quorum-based rollback decisions; observability hooks and dashboards; end-to-end tests and stability guards. Stored configs remain backward-compatible; new flags enabled behind feature flag rollout.unified_v2.

Checklist: 
- [x] Controller state machine + reconciliation loop
- [x] Canary weight scheduler + A/B traffic splitter
- [x] Shadow probing engine (non-impacting requests + KV cache handling)
- [x] Auto-rollback evaluator (multi-metric, quorum, time windows)
- [x] Observability metrics and tracing spans
- [x] E2E tests for canary->rollback, A/B split reports, and shadow probing isolation
- [x] Docs update + example rollout manifest

Related: ENG-2412 (unified rollout design), ENG-2478 (rollback quorum), SUP-4523 (customer incident analysis), previous PRs pr-81234 and pr-241999 for rollback metrics and safety guards.

review_comments: Asha: Please add more tests around KV cache warming when shadow traffic is enabled; ensure shadow requests don't populate live caches in Dedicated customers.
Jordan: Addressed in commit 4c3d2a; added an explicit shadow_cache: false flag and tests that validate no KV writes occur during shadow probing.
Liam: The quorum algorithm looks good, but we should cap rollback frequency to avoid flip-flop on noisy metrics. Suggest adding a cool-down window.
Jordan: Added a 5m cooldown and unit tests to demonstrate behavior (see rollback/evaluator_test.go).
Marta: Observability looks thorough; can you add a dashboard template to the observability repo?
Jordan: Added observability/rollouts_dashboard.json and referenced it in docs. CI flake observed on e2e slow path; retriggered and passing.

Security review: Ensure that A/B splitting honors tenant isolation and does not leak sensitive routing keys to logs. Jordan: redacted routing tokens in tracing and added an opt-in flag for verbose routing debug.
merge_summary: Merged by squash via web UI. Includes 5 commits squashed into a single commit. Feature gated behind rollout.unified_v2 and runtime config defaults to off for backward compatibility. Post-merge: scheduled gradual rollout to staging cluster, monitoring dashboards connected, and a 72h observability window for metric regressions.
post_merge_tasks:
Enable feature flag in staging (50% of clusters)
Monitor rollout.rate and rollback.count metrics
Run canary e2e on dedicated and private images
Coordinate with on-call SRE for 72h window
notes_for_release_manager: No breaking changes. Recommend including short note: 'Unified rollouts: new workflow combining canary, A/B, and shadow probing with auto-rollback safety guards (feature-gated)'. Inform customers via changelog that the feature is opt-in.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for quorum logic and cooldown windows, integration tests for traffic split, and e2e scenarios simulating metric regressions to validate auto-rollback. Repro instructions in e2e/README.md.
changelog_entry: Improvement: Unified rollout workflow (canary/A-B/shadow) with metric-driven auto-rollback and safety guards (feature-gated).
observability_impact: New metrics: rollout_stage_duration_seconds, rollout_rollback_count_total, rollout_quarantine_events_total, rollout_shadow_probe_latency_seconds. Dashboards and alert runbooks added.
security_impact: No new data plane auth changes. Shadow traffic explicitly configured to not write to shared KV caches by default; tracing redacts routing keys.
rollback_plan: If rollout causes regressions: disable rollout.unified_v2 feature flag, trigger emergency rollback via /api/v1/rollouts/<id>/force-rollback, roll back candidate model to pinned stable version, and escalate to on-call SRE.
